description:
Checks an acknowledgment, trial reminder, renewal reminder, price-change, annual-terms or cancellation-confirmation email against the laws that require it, and returns a verified template that passes (subject, text, html with merge tags) plus required_by (the laws that make it mandatory for this plan).
Example: {"kind":"trial_reminder","subject":"Your trial ends soon","text":"…","terms":{"price":19.99,"interval":"month","trial_days":14,"cancel_url":"https://acme.example/account/cancel","merchant_name":"Acme"}}.
For WHEN each email must be sent, use get_notice_schedule.

as_of.description: Evaluate the law as of this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

jurisdictions.description: Where the business sells: "all" (default) or state codes like ["US-CA","US-NY"] ("CA" works too). Federal law is always included.

plan.description: Plan name or price_… (default: the one named)

site.description: site_… whose Stripe prices judge it (default: your Stripe site).

terms.description: price, interval, cancel_url (optional with site); price_change: NEW price

cancel_timing.description: When a cancellation takes effect (default period_end).

cancel_url.description: https URL where subscribers cancel online (used in generated text).

interval.description: Billing interval: day, week, month or year.

intro_percent_off.description: Or the promo as % off (coupon percent_off).

previous_price.description: price_change: price before the change, major units.

support_contact.description: Support email / URL for the template.

trial_days.description: Free-trial days (0 or absent = no trial).

text.description: Plain-text body (give text, html or both).

name: check_email
title: Check a subscription lifecycle email
